smoke_tests.name: openapi-pydantic-route-contract
smoke_tests.code:
from fastapi import FastAPI
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Item(BaseModel):
    name: str
    price: float = Field(gt=0)

app = FastAPI(title='Static API')

@app.post('/items/{item_id}', response_model=Item)
def put_item(item_id: int, item: Item) -> Item:
    assert item_id == 7
    return item

schema = app.openapi()
assert schema['info']['title'] == 'Static API'
assert 'post' in schema['paths']['/items/{item_id}']
assert schema['components']['schemas']['Item']['properties']['price']['exclusiveMinimum'] == 0
assert put_item(7, Item(name='widget', price='2.5')).price == 2.5

smoke_tests.name: sync-async-queue-bridge
smoke_tests.code:
import asyncio
import janus

async def check():
    queue = janus.Queue()
    await queue.async_q.put('ok')
    assert queue.sync_q.get_nowait() == 'ok'
    queue.close()
    await queue.wait_closed()

asyncio.run(check())

model-validation-schema-and-json
smoke_tests.code:
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, TypeAdapter

class User(BaseModel):
    name: str
    age: int = Field(ge=0)

user = User.model_validate({'name': 'Ada', 'age': '37'})
assert user.age == 37
assert User.model_json_schema()['properties']['age']['minimum'] == 0
assert user.model_dump_json() == '{\"name\":\"Ada\",\"age\":37}'
assert TypeAdapter(list[int]).validate_python(['1', 2]) == [1, 2]

runtime-sdk.description: Static CPython runtime SDK for PySuture. Builds no generic python.exe and contains no optional third-party libraries.

stdlib.description: Build only CPython and statically linked standard-library extension modules.

tkinter-experimental.description: Experimental no-extraction tkinter pack using static Tcl/Tk 9 and an in-memory ZipFS. Kept outside full until dedicated SDK-linked verification is green.

pydantic-core-experimental.description: Build the pydantic-core version required by current stable Pydantic as an experimental Rust static pack without adding it to the full supported catalog.

pydantic-core-latest-experimental.description: Build the latest stable standalone pydantic-core release as an experimental Rust static pack without adding it to the full supported catalog.

pydantic-core-2-47-experimental.description: Preserve the previously verified pydantic-core 2.47.0 Rust static pack while latest validation advances.

pydantic-experimental.description: Build current stable Pydantic and its exact static pydantic-core dependency as experimental packs without adding them to the full supported catalog.

fastapi-experimental.description: Build current stable FastAPI with its exact Pydantic and Starlette dependency closure as experimental packs without adding it to the full supported catalog.

full.description: Build CPython plus every configured third-party library integration. Pure libraries come from third_party_library_catalog; native or patched libraries remain under Lib/<name>/setup.py.
